feed.title: NPR Topics: National
feed.subtitle: Follow NPR National News for reporting across the United States. Explore coverage of economic affordability, immigration, climate, environmental policy, justice and social trends.

entry.title: First-time homebuyers remain scarce, but a record share of them pay all cash
entry.summary: A new report finds generational wealth is widening the divide between homebuyers and those priced out. The median age of first-time buyers also remains at a record high.

entry.title: Sen. Gillibrand says Democrats must end Iran war, hold Trump accountable. But how?
entry.summary: Sen. Kirsten Gillibrand spoke with Morning Edition about Democrats' priorities, from lowering costs to ending the Iran war. But questions remain about how they'll deliver.

entry.title: Trump's arch is on the verge of federal approval. But a judge could block construction
entry.summary: A federal panel will meet to consider the arch for final approval on Thursday, and the government said it may begin construction later that same day. Critics hope a judge will intervene last-minute.

entry.title: As budgets tighten, people are breaking out their library cards
entry.summary: Some Americans squeezed by high prices are relying more on their local libraries for things like books, streaming services and high-priced items like musical instruments and sewing machines.

entry.title: The South flexes political power in midterms, sets regional influence in 2028 election
entry.summary: Tuesday's dramatic midterm results have transformed the electoral map, ensuring the path to future power for Democrats and Republicans must run through the South and its diverse voting population.

entry.title: A look at how the NYPD built its surveillance system and the fight for transparency
entry.summary: New York City police surveillance systems were paid for and adopted without the kind of public oversight cities usually require.

entry.title: Where voters stand on state ballot measures, from abortion to LGBTQ rights to guns
entry.summary: Voters in dozens of states considered 146 statewide ballot measures this midterm cycle, on topics spanning LGBTQ rights, wealth taxes, abortion, redistricting, guns and more.

entry.title: Chuck Schumer heralds Democrats' 'generational remake' of Senate
entry.summary: In remarks the day after his party flipped control of Congress, the Senate Minority Leader said voters had spoken clearly about their priorities, and said it's up to the Democratic party to deliver.

entry.title: Mike Johnson will step aside as top House Republican next Congress
entry.summary: After Tuesday's bruising defeat for Republicans, House Speaker Mike Johnson will not stay on as minority leader come January.

entry.title: Back in the majority, Democrats have plans for a long list of Trump investigations
entry.summary: Democrats will have the ability to subpoena records and compel individuals to testify. The Epstein files, Elon Musk, the Iran war and Trump's business interests may all come under the microscope.
